aggregation_stories.title: Costco's Q4 Sales Rise 11.3% as Digital Momentum Remains Strong
aggregation_stories.summary: Costco reported strong fourth-quarter net sales, increasing 11.3% year-over-year to $93.9 billion, driven significantly by its digitally enabled business. Comparable sales rose 9.4% companywide, with digital comparable sales surging 19.5%. The company's digital growth outpaced that of competitors like Target and BJ's Wholesale, although Costco's stock has recently underperformed the industry.
